stem: Which excerpt from “Car Talk” best matches the feeling expressed by the speaker in line 7 of the poem?
instruction:
Read line 7 of the poem.

I'm only twelve, but I get to drive!

options.label: A
options.text: we got into the car that first time

options.label: B
options.text: Dad and I drove around, saying almost nothing

options.label: C
options.text: that now-aging permit first found its way into my eager hands

options.label: D
options.text: a small plastic card verifying my right to drive

visual_elements: I'm only twelve, but I get to drive!
